messages:
mia: Short RFC follow-up: introduce soft_hint for prefix pins to reduce churn on bursty workloads.
trent: TL;DR: soft_hint keeps prefix resident but at lower eviction priority, with credit-backed admission.
julia: How do we avoid stale reads if a soft-hinted prefix gets demoted?
oscar: Add a small residency_epoch in prefix metadata. On demote increment epoch; readers compare and rehydrate if mismatch.
mia: API sketch:
POST /v1/prefix/pin { prefix: "team/x/abc", pin: true, soft_hint: true, hint_ttl: 15 }
trent: Admission: tenants have soft_credits. Each resident soft_hint consumes 1 credit. Credits regen slowly; exhaustion -> 429 on soft_hint requests.
julia: Metrics: soft_hint_grants, soft_hint_denies, soft_to_hard_promotions, rawe_rehydrates. Also per-tenant credit usage.
oscar: Edgecases: cross-shard handoff must carry epoch + remaining TTL. Crash recovery: reconcile credits on node restart.
infra-bot: [info] feature-flag prefix_soft_hint enabled on canary 5%.
mia: Rollout plan: canary 5% (hint_ttl=10, credits=2) -> monitor 24h -> 25% if stable. Targets: rawe_rehydrates < 1%, soft_hint_denies < 0.2%.
trent: Dev owners: oscar runtime + admission, julia metrics + console, mia docs + RFC, i'll do SDK/api.
oscar: Also add auto-throttle: if tenant causes many soft_to_hard in window, lower their regen rate for 30m.
julia: LGTM.
mia: I'll update RFC & canary playbook.
